column1: # Reviewed semantic evidence for the OPEN four-entity transition helper.
# The function was checked with OPEN-qualified disassembly/CFG, all four call sites, callees, strings, data
# references, adjacent boundaries, generated Ghidra candidate, source history, current match state, and vendor/FID controls.

column6: modes 0, 2, and 3 activate four 40-byte records at indices 24 through 27 with object id 0x13, copy one position, clear rotation, and choose the initial Y scale; modes 0 and 2 run a 48-frame staggered Y-scale and 12-bit yaw animation; modes 1 and 2 deactivate all four records
column7: the scene-3 and ending controllers provide all four supported modes and stack-local positions; three references resolve to fields of opening_entity_state; calls opening_render_frame and VSync; no strings
column8: a0 is repeatedly sign-extended to s16 for mode selection; each a1 caller supplies a VECTOR-shaped stack object and the body copies all four words into the entity position; s16 loop/index behavior and u16 scale bounds are direct instruction evidence
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and Psy-Q/FID attribution; the custom entity-pool indices, object id, render loop, and scene-controller call sites prove game-owned opening policy
column12: complete semantic C with supported identity, signature, aggregate ownership, calls, CFG, constants, widths, and field accesses; retail additionally retains a semantically dead three-word position snapshot at stack offsets 16 through 24, producing a 56-byte rather than 32-byte frame and downstream temporary-register and label-offset differences under the pinned probe; dead source is intentionally not introduced
